```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
```

```{r connect to vespadb}
# Prepare the login request
url <- "https://uat-db.vespawatch.be/login/"
body <- list(username = Sys.getenv("vespadb_username"), 
             password = Sys.getenv("vespadb_password"))

# Make the POST request and store the response
h <- handle(url)
response <- POST(
  url,
  body = body,
  encode = "json",
  add_headers(`Content-Type` = "application/json"),
  handle = h
)

# Check if the login was successful
if (status_code(response) == 200) {
  message("Login successful!")
} else {
  stop("Login failed: ", content(response, "text"))
}
```
